subject: Mutual action plan & GPU phasing — commitment, lead times, acceptance criteria
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@novathera.com>

Cc: procurement@novathera.com
Date: 2027-03-22T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & GPU phasing — commitment, lead times, acceptance criteria

Thanks, Irene — this looks promising. A few quick clarifying Qs from our side before we review the MAP doc with the executive team: 

1) Lead times: you list a 10–12 week lead for Dedicated GPU pool tranches. Can you confirm that includes procurement, capacity reservation, and initial validation window on our VPC?
2) Acceptance criteria: we need a concrete SLA/latency target for 95th percentile inference at our baseline batch sizes (single-request latency target is important for our UX team).
3) Cost staging: Novathera needs an option to stagger commitments across two tranches — we prefer not to pay for full capacity upfront. Is a staged commit and tranche-based billing supported in the MAP?

Looping in procurement for budget/contract cadence. If you can provide a short timeline we can use in the internal decision memo, that would help.

Best,
Emma Li
Head of ML Engineering, Novathera
emma.li@novathera.com
+1 (415) 555-0124
From: irene.choi@redwood.ai <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@novathera.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, procurement@novathera.com
Date: 2027-03-22T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & GPU phasing — commitment, lead times, acceptance criteria

Emma — great questions. Short answers up top, details and a proposed phasing below.

1) Lead times: 10–12 weeks is end-to-end from signed commitment to handover of the first Dedicated tranche in the Redwood Private offering (customer VPC peering, KMS integration, kernel/quantization tuning, and production smoke tests on sample prompts). We can accelerate to 6–8 weeks for a smaller initial tranche (up to 25% of requested pool) if you accept a shorter validation window and staged rollout.

2) Acceptance criteria: proposed 95th percentile token-level latency target: 240ms for single-request 16k context with float16 quantization on T4-equivalent SKU (we'll provide a per-model profile). For heavier models or longer contexts we'll provide fallback targets in the MAP. We include an initial evaluation run of 48h with your canonical prompts to validate.

3) Staged commits: supported. MAP will include tranche schedule, billing start per tranche, and an option to convert remaining optional tranches into firm commits 30 days prior to provisioning.

Added below is a recommended MAP timeline and next steps we can insert into the exec memo. I'll have Karthik add the SKU & procurement milestones in a follow-up.

--- Proposed MAP timeline for Novathera (draft) ---
Week 0: Sign MAP + SOW (DocuSign link included)
Week 1–2: Kickoff, security questionnaire (SOC2 evidence), networking prep (VPC peering)
Week 3–6: Staging tranche provisioning (up to 25% capacity), model onboarding, kernel tuning
Week 7–8: Validation run (48–72h), SLA measurement against 95p latency target
Week 9–12: Full tranche provisioning for remaining committed capacity (if staggered commit exercised)

Key deliverables: MAP v3 (attached), GPU sizing workbook (attached), acceptance criteria doc (included in MAP).

Attachments: MAP-Novathera-v3.pdf; gpu-sizing-proposal.xlsx

Next steps:
- Procurement: review DocuSign and confirm billing cadence (monthly vs. quarterly).
- Novathera ML: provide a 24–36 prompt evaluation set and representative request sizes by EOD Fri.
- Redwood: Karthik to share SKU options & lead-time delta for accelerated tranche.

Thanks — I can join your exec sync on Mon if helpful.

Best,
Irene Choi
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai, Emma Li <emma.li@novathera.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, procurement@novathera.com
Date: 2027-03-23T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Mutual action plan & GPU phasing — commitment, lead times, acceptance criteria

Emma — adding the technical sizing detail. Summary below, full workbook attached.

SKU guidance (example):
- Stage A (staging tranche): 8x T4-equivalent GPUs (mixed-precision) — supports ~15 QPS at 16k context (95p latency ~220–260ms depending on prompt distribution).
- Stage B (full tranche): 32x A10s or 24x A100-p4 (depending on your latency requirements and concurrency patterns).

Lead time deltas:
- T4-equivalent tranche (lower-power SKU) — 6–8 weeks accelerated pathway (limited kernel tuning, soft isolation).
- A10/A100 tranche — standard 10–12 weeks (includes additional procurement and capacity reservation).

Validation & acceptance: 48h smoke run with your prompt set; success if 95p latency < agreed target for 95% of the prompts and no more than 1 severity-2 incident during validation window. We capture per-token cost and sample traces (redwood console links) as part of acceptance evidence.

Contractual notes for procurement team: staging tranche billing begins on provisioning date; conversion of optional tranches must be notified via DocuSign amendment 30 days prior to provisioning. I'll attach suggested SOW language in the shared Doc.

Attachments: gpu-sizing-proposal.xlsx; redwood-commit-terms-2027.docx

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Dedicated Products, Redwood Inference
